plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around 2022 a witness named David Grusch handed hundreds of pages of documents to the Intelligence Community Inspector General, the watchdog for US spy agencies, then led by Thomas Monheim. According to Michels, the watchdog called the claims urgent and credible, and the pages described a secret, long-running program to recover crashed UFOs, which would mean the government has been hiding such material.
